title: Very trendy!
text: Very trendy!. This is the blanket you see on the end of beds in the decorator magazines - very large knit blanket - cream color - looking very fluffy and comfortable.  It is all that, but the yarn tends  to cast off puffs of yarn, which can be a problem.  It’s very heavy in weight, too, which may be great with the new fervor for heavy blankets.  Will look great on the end of a bed so a gift to the younger set may be appropriate and appreciated!  Had to cut back on the stars because of the loose “puff” problem.

product_metadata.title: Eon Luxe Comfort Chunky Knit Blanket - Large - Decorative Handmade Knit Throw 50x60 inches (Frothy Cream)
